readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Start with the opening chapter, which deliberately presents conclusions before the demonstration. Then choose one essential service and follow its physical, industrial, and social requirements. The appendices show how estimates were constructed and how their assumptions should be read. The remaining-scarcity chapters keep the promise of enough distinct from a promise of everything. This book offers readers a way to evaluate abundance claims without choosing optimism blindly. Its central test is whether productive possibility becomes secure access for actual people. Read the full argument to judge that passage, where technical promise becomes a social decision.
